internalBreakdown.component: Creating a MySQL database and performing queries
Practical file (14 Python programs, 14 SQL queries)

chapters.name: Introduction to Computer System
topics: Evolution of computing devices; components of a computer system and their interconnections; input and output devices
Units and types of memory: primary and secondary; data deletion, recovery and security concerns
Software: system and application, generic and specific purpose
outcomes: Identify the components of a computer system

chapters.name: Python Basics
topics: Execution modes; program structure, indentation, identifiers, keywords, constants, variables
Operators and precedence; data types, mutable and immutable; statements, expressions, comments
Input and output; type conversion; debugging
outcomes: Create Python programs using different data types, lists and dictionaries

chapters.name: Control Statements
topics: if-else, if-elif-else
while loop, for loop

chapters.name: Lists
topics: Creating, initialising, traversing and manipulating lists
len, list, append, insert, count, index, remove, pop, reverse, sort, min, max, sum

chapters.name: Dictionary
topics: Key-value pairs: creating, initialising, traversing, updating and deleting
dict, len, keys, values, items, update, del, clear

chapters.name: Introduction to NumPy
topics: Creating NumPy arrays from lists

units.name: Database Concepts and the Structured Query Language

chapters.name: Database Concepts
topics: Need for databases; database management system
Relational model: domain, tuple, relation, candidate, primary and alternate key

chapters.name: Structured Query Language
topics: Advantages of SQL; DDL, DQL, DML; MySQL; data types
CREATE DATABASE, CREATE TABLE, DROP, ALTER
SELECT, FROM, WHERE with relational operators, BETWEEN, logical operators, IS NULL, IS NOT NULL
INSERT, DELETE, UPDATE
outcomes: Retrieve and manipulate data in an RDBMS using SQL

chapters.name: Emerging Trends
topics: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural language processing
Immersive experience: AR, VR; robotics
Big data and its characteristics; Internet of Things, sensors, smart cities
Cloud computing and services (SaaS, IaaS, PaaS); grid computing; blockchain
outcomes: Identify emerging trends in information technology
